content:
Changes the password for the specified user.
If you reset a user's password, Tenable Vulnerability Management automatically resets the user's
login_fail_count  and lockout  attributes to 0 . If you specify that the password is temporary,
the user will be forced to reset their password upon next login.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The unique ID of the user whose password you want to change.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string <password>
The new password for the user.
boolean
Indicates whether the password is temporary ( true ) or not ( false ). If
this parameter is not specified, Tenable Vulnerability Management defaults
to false .
